thread:
li: quick note from today

we tested ember-embed-micro (fp16) vs ember-embed-micro-int6 on the multilingual holdout (20k). baseline recall@10=0.926, int6=0.902. notable that cn/ja short queries (<=4 tokens) dropped more than en: cn r@1 0.73 -> 0.51; en r@1 0.78 -> 0.66.

jun: thanks. did you try per-tensor vs per-channel?

li: only per-channel so far. did L2 norm at search time and small whitening, which recovered ~0.06 r@1 on cn short.

maya: interesting. that suggests tokenization sparsity + embedding geometry mismatch. can we share token-length distribution for cn/ja vs en?

ci-bot: logs -> https://internal.ci/firebrand/runs/20260211-103000 (artifacts: recall_by_lang.csv, short_query_stats.json)

ops-bot: perf: int6 shows 1.8x throughput and -30% memory on staging. hybrid routing could be used for cn/ja short queries. created INF-8369.

jun: propose a standard checklist for future int6 onboardings: 1) recall by length and by language 2) idflip histogram 3) pearson cosine correlation 4) UMAP per-length 5) accept criteria table 6) perf cost/benefit and hybrid routing plan.

maya: +1 for checklist. can we add a small STS-style pairwise slope test to see if quantization induces systematic scalar shrinkage?

li: added. I'll roll checklist into the onboarding playbook.
